title: Chapter 983
text:
"You …" The Kunde Race leader was stunned and looked at Han Xiao.

A single person can defeat our Kunde Race? This was the first time he had heard such a domineering self-introduction.

Just what was the background of this stranger in front of him?

He did not believe it subconsciously, but he immediately realized that he was facing an even more advanced civilization. The other party had a Super system, and anything was possible. He had to throw away his outdated views.

He did not understand Han Xiao's identity in the dynasty, but for him to dare say such words, he had to be an unimaginable figure.

If that was the case, this self-introduction was really straightforward, and he immediately understood the other party's position.

He was a prisoner with no bargaining power, but this big shot who he had never met before actually agreed to his last request?

This was … why?!

Pity? Charity?

Or is he pretending to agree so that I can cooperate?

He was filled with doubt.

When he first made his request, he did not have much hope. To think that someone would really agree to his request.

All of a sudden, the Kunde Race leader was filled with disbelief and did not know what to say.

"Are you worried that I'm joking?" Han Xiao looked at him and slowly said, "To put it bluntly, you have no value in being cheated by me. Since I've promised you, I will definitely fulfill my promise."

The Kunde Race leader could not help but ask, "Why are you helping me?"

"Good question."

Han Xiao chuckled and said, "I'm a person who cares for others. Just treat it as me sympathizing with the Kunde Race. In any case, it's not difficult for me to deal with your request."

By the side, Tarrokov's mouth twitched.

Brother, can we have some face?

You're also partly responsible for the Kunde Race's defeat! You're making it seem like we're the bad guys!

The thickness of your face is probably enough to block a psionic cannon … Oh, it really seems like it can.

While Tarrokov was cursing by the side, the Kunde Race leader was extremely touched.

He was like a traveler who had reached the end of his road and was about to fall into the deepest darkness. However, in the final light of his vision, he saw someone reaching out a hand to him, willing to give him a hand.

"Thank you … It is my fortune to meet someone like you at the last moment of my life. Unfortunately, I have nothing to repay you with."

The Kunde Race leader clenched his fists and suppressed his emotions. His tone was filled with gratitude.

"Hehe, it's okay. I don't need anything in return." Han Xiao laughed. Even he didn't believe what he said.

Hearing this, the Kunde Race leader was even more touched.

This Black Star is really a good person who cares about the universe!

Pa!

Tarrokov covered his face and complained helplessly.

This scene was simply filled with the absurdity of fate. Their entire clan had been wiped out, yet they still had to be grateful to him?!

'You've Got Me!' Not only did he kill, he also wanted to kill silently. He wanted to make the enemy feel grateful to the murderer without them knowing. What kind of disgusting taste was this!

At this moment, Old Ta came to a conclusion.

— — Black Star is indeed a pervert.

It's best to stay away from him in the future. I'm about to retire, and I don't want to be led astray by him.

Han Xiao smiled and walked out of the interrogation room with Tarrokov, leaving the Kunde Race leader alone in the room.

After walking out of the room, Tarrokov turned around and looked at him with confusion.

"Black Star, why did you agree to his request?"

He truly did not expect this to happen. He originally thought that Black Star was only here to be a bystander. He did not expect Black Star to suddenly do this, and he did not know what his motive was.

Han Xiao shrugged with a smile. "I'm in a good mood today, and I want to be a good person."

"So, you really didn't joke around with him just now?"

"Of course not. I'm very serious … Wait a minute, I have a bad taste? Do you have some misunderstanding about me? "

Ignoring Han Xiao's words, Tarrokov frowned.

"But you just expressed that you would not interfere with the dynasty's matters in front of the Ruler. Now, you're saying that you're going to change your attitude and support keeping these captives?"

"Ha, there's nothing that can't change in the world. Can't I suddenly change my mind?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"I understand." Tarrokov nodded. "I will report your opinion to the Ruler later. As for whether the higher-ups will consider it or not, it's none of my business."

"That's enough." Han Xiao smiled.

At this moment, Tarrokov looked around and said in a low voice, "Tell me honestly, what are your intentions?"

"Hmm? Didn't I say that I'm in a good mood today? "

"Haha."

Tarrokov had a 'don't lie to me' expression on his face.

Seeing that, Han Xiao shook his head helplessly and said, "Alright, alright. I'll tell you. The population of the Kunde Race is in the trillions and has reached the scale of a Star Cluster Civilization. Although it will take a long time for them to undergo cultural changes, they will be a precious resource. If I can settle them in my territory, I will have a large amount of manpower, consumers, and soldiers in the future. The dynasty is huge and does not need the Kunde Race's population. However, this is an opportunity for me to develop."

Hearing that, a smile appeared on Tarrokov's face.

That's right, this is the Black Star that I know. How could he be so kind?

As expected of you.

Thinking about it, Tarrokov felt that there was nothing wrong with Han Xiao's plan. If the dynasty wanted to keep the Kunde Race, they would have to choose a place to settle them down. The population would affect the prosperity of the dynasty, and there would definitely be allies eyeing this piece of meat. The way he saw it, Black Star had already made this request.

As for agreeing to the so-called last wish … he understood Han Xiao's character too well. This was most likely just an excuse.

You have accepted the S Grade Mission [Kunde Race Leader's Last Wish]!

Mission Introduction: The Kunde Race has lost the war and has become the captives of the dynasty. Their future is uncertain. In his despair, the Kunde Race leader made his final request to you.]

Mission Requirements: 1. Settle the Kunde Race down and provide them with protection during the cultural changes.

2. Take revenge on the mastermind who used the Kunde Race to deal with the Red Empire.

Failure Condition: The Kunde Race's population is less than 80% of the original population.

First requirement completed. Reward: 3,000,000,000 Experience, + 10000 Kunde Race Favorability (Current Relationship: -1,500, Relationship: [Hatred]), x2 Random Rewards, + 4 Political Assets (Kunde Race).

The Kunde Race has entered the [Awakening Era]. + 10% Super Awakening Rate.

Second requirement completed. Reward: 1,200,000,000 Experience, + 15000 Kunde Race Favorability, x1 Designated Blank Character Summon Card, [The Enemy], [Proof of Leadership], Special Skill [Kunde Rage].

[The Enemy]: The more HP you lose, the higher your damage will be. This bonus can be stacked up to 25% and will reset after leaving combat. This effect can be applied to summoned creatures, machinery, and equipment …

[Proof of Leadership]: When you are the leader of a faction, you will receive an overall bonus. The bonus will increase according to the size and level of the faction. There is no upper limit.

[Kunde Rage]: Upon activation, lose 5% HP/s for a maximum of 40 seconds. You will receive 2.0x Psychic Resistance, + 5% Damage, -5% INT, -20% CHA, and -10% LUK. At the same time, you will be immune to all abnormal mental states other than [Rage]. Cooldown: 5 minutes. Let the flames of rage fill your mind!

As soon as he saw the mission description, Han Xiao decided that he had to do this mission no matter what. The reward was beyond his expectations, and it gave him a big surprise!

It was simply too generous!

Han Xiao did not have any expression on his face, but he was overjoyed in his heart.

While the leader of the Kunde Race was not a Super, his identity as the leader of a Star Cluster civilization meant that he would receive extremely high rewards.

The first requirement was the normal Random Reward and experience. What Han Xiao cared about was the four Political Asset reward. Apart from increasing the efficiency of gaining experience, it also meant that he would have a say in the Kunde Race.

The dynasty wanted to turn the Kunde Race into a vassal civilization, but even if they were crippled, they would still have the foundation of a Star Cluster civilization.

What Han Xiao had said to Tarrokov was not false. If the Kunde Race was located in his territory, their large population would provide him with many benefits.

After completing this mission, the Kunde Race would enter a new era, and their Super awakening rate would increase. Although ten percent did not seem like much, it was not a small number when it involved billions of people. The reward also included a high Favorability with the Kunde Race, and their relationship would rise to [Reverence]. This meant that the Kunde Race would become his ally to a certain extent, and Supers were equivalent to a source of soldiers.

However, most of the Grade S missions had very simple introductions. The first requirement was to provide protection, and there was no mention of how long it would take for the mission to be considered complete. Han Xiao estimated that he would have to wait until the dynasty removed the seal on the Kunde Race. Thus, it would take a long time for him to complete the mission.

However, the second requirement was different.

According to the Kunde Race leader's request, the goal was to take revenge on the mastermind who made use of them.

What made Han Xiao decide to accept the mission was the reward for the second requirement.

Needless to say, the Designated Character Summon Card was a good thing, and the three abilities that were rewarded almost blinded him.

[The Enemy] was an extremely practical talent that was extremely suitable for him.

To an ordinary person, the lower their health, the higher the damage dealt. When the damage was stacked to the highest, they would only have a sliver of health left, which was equivalent to going berserk on the verge of death.

However, with Han Xiao's health recovery rate, he would be able to recover back to full health in a matter of minutes. This twenty-five percent damage increase was like a gift from the heavens!

Furthermore, it was also suitable for summoned creatures and machinery, directly increasing the damage output of the entire Mech Legion!

[Proof of Leadership] was one of the most powerful abilities. In Han Xiao's previous life, it was extremely famous among the players and had the title of 'Half Template'.

Players could have this ability as well!

As the leader of a faction, they would be able to activate the effect of this talent, which was very similar to a template. Players could also create their own armed forces like Supers and recruit ordinary NPCs. Guilds were also a type of faction, and they would be recognized by this talent.

In the future versions, players would have a stable channel to obtain [Proof of Leadership]. In order to activate this talent, a large number of players would create their own factions or guilds, and their lives would enter a new stage.

The bonus of this talent depended on the size of the faction. To normal players who had no money, time, or charisma, even if they had this talent, it would not be of much use. Only some tycoons, studios, and large guilds would be able to utilize this talent the best. Very few people would be able to obtain a significant bonus.

In his previous life, Han Xiao had never activated [Proof of Leadership] as a lone wolf. However, he was very clear that the bonus of [Proof of Leadership] … was extremely powerful!

"If I had this talent now, the effect would be … unimaginable!"

Han Xiao was secretly excited. He was extremely passionate about any ability that could greatly increase his strength.

The last ability, [Kunde's Rage], also made his eyes light up. It was also a good ability.

The 2.0x bonus to Mental Resistance was equivalent to doubling his Mental Resistance. It was extremely impressive!

Mental Resistance had always been Han Xiao's weakness. Any ability that could increase his Mental Resistance would attract his attention.

Furthermore, during the duration of the skill, he would be immune to all negative mental statuses. It was extremely overpowered and basically meant that he would be immune to all mental control skills.

The skill depleted his HP. He would lose 5% of his HP every second, and his HP would be emptied in 20 seconds. This status could only last for a maximum of 40 seconds. The percentage of HP loss was very high, and normal people would only be able to activate it for a few seconds at most.

However, Han Xiao's HP regeneration was not low either. According to his total HP, under the most ideal circumstances, the HP regeneration from HP to MP regeneration was equivalent to around 10% HP per second. If he could hold on, activating it for 40 seconds would not be a problem for Han Xiao.

The only thing that confused Han Xiao was the name of the skill.

Since he was enraged, shouldn't he increase his Attack Power? Why did he increase his Resistance?

Could this be Incompetent Rage? The legendary "Kill me if you have the ability"?

"These three skills are very practical. As long as I can complete the mission, my actual combat power will increase by a lot. Especially [Proof of Leadership], the sooner I obtain it, the better." Han Xiaoxin calculated.

The second requirement was to take revenge on the mastermind. The mission did not explain to what extent the revenge would be considered a success. He had to figure out the method himself, just like the Godora's Lineage mission.

However, such a generous reward was really tempting, and Han Xiao decided to try his best to complete this mission.

He was extremely happy that he had such a pleasant surprise on this trip.

…

After deactivating the remote projection and returning to his office, Tarrokov immediately contacted Uranril and sent her the interrogation record. At the same time, he reported Han Xiao's actions to the Ruler.

"You're saying that after Black Star inspected the captives, he changed his attitude and expressed his support for educating them?"

"Yes."

"Hmm …" Uranril fell into deep thought. "What's the reason?"

"He said that it's for the population …" Tarrokov repeated what Han Xiao had said.

Uranril narrowed her eyes and nodded. "Since it's the opinion of an ally, we have to consider it carefully."

In terms of the benefits of the dynasty, Black Star's position was far higher than the defeated Kunde Race. After all, National Pillars were rare, but there were many vassal races.

Furthermore, Black Star was an important contributor to this war, and his opinion would be valued by the dynasty.

In truth, to the dynasty, settling the Kunde Race down was an extremely simple matter and was not that important. There was no problem in placing them in the territory of the Black Star Corps. Not only would they increase the population of their ally's territory, but they would also be able to help monitor them.

However, Black Star was not their only ally, and they had to balance the opinions of all parties before deciding if they should give this piece of meat to Black Star.

As for dealing with the mastermind, it was not only the Kunde Race's leader's idea but also the dynasty's as well.

While their opponent was the Kunde Race, the Supercluster and Star Cluster civilizations that had given away the technology were the true culprits, and the dynasty did not have the habit of letting them off.

Even without mentioning the reason for revenge, the exploration of the Flickering World had yet to end, and if the enemies who were scheming in the dark were to create more native civilizations, it would greatly hinder the progress of the dynasty.

Regardless of whether it was for public or private reasons, the dynasty would not allow the mastermind to continue causing trouble.

Han Xiao's attitude was exactly what the dynasty wanted.

"Since that's the case, we have to investigate which organization threw the spaceship to the Kunde Race."

A cold light flashed through Uranril's eyes.
